Symbol.Script_1D:
! ===== SCRIPT MAITRE ===== IF longBaguette < 0.20 THEN longBaguette = 0.20 IF diamBaguette < 0.03 THEN diamBaguette = 0.03 IF diamBaguette > longBaguette / 3 THEN diamBaguette = longBaguette / 3
nbBaguettes = MAX(1, INT(nbBaguettes)) nbGrignes = MAX(1, INT(nbGrignes))
IF espacement < diamBaguette THEN espacement = diamBaguette
r = diamBaguette / 2 largTotale = (nbBaguettes - 1) * espacement + diamBaguette
Symbol.Script_3D:
! ===== SCRIPT 3D ===== PEN stylo
FOR i = 1 TO nbBaguettes ADD 0, r + (i - 1) * espacement, 0
angAlt = (((i MOD 2) * 2) - 1) * 2.5 ADD longBaguette / 2, 0, 0 ROTz angAlt ADD -longBaguette / 2, 0, 0
GOSUB 100 DEL 4 NEXT i
HOTSPOT 0, 0, 0 HOTSPOT longBaguette, 0, 0 HOTSPOT 0, largTotale, 0 HOTSPOT longBaguette, largTotale, 0 HOTSPOT longBaguette / 2, largTotale / 2, diamBaguette
END
100: MATERIAL matPain
ADD 0, 0, r REVOLVE 9, 360, 16 + 32, 0, 0, 0, 0.04 * longBaguette, 0.55 * r, 0, 0.10 * longBaguette, 0.85 * r, 0, 0.18 * longBaguette, r, 0, 0.82 * longBaguette, r, 0, 0.90 * longBaguette, 0.85 * r, 0, 0.96 * longBaguette, 0.55 * r, 0, 0.995 * longBaguette, 0.25 * r, 0, longBaguette, 0, 0 DEL 1
IF grignes THEN MATERIAL matGrigne dGr = 0.6 * longBaguette / nbGrignes lGr = 0.6 * dGr FOR g = 1 TO nbGrignes gx = 0.2 * longBaguette + (g - 0.5) * dGr ADD gx, 0, 2 * r - 0.005 ROTz 30 ADD -lGr / 2, -0.004, 0 BLOCK lGr, 0.008, 0.008 DEL 3 NEXT g ENDIF RETURN
Symbol.Script_2D:
! ===== SCRIPT 2D ===== PEN stylo
HOTSPOT2 0, 0 HOTSPOT2 longBaguette, 0 HOTSPOT2 0, largTotale HOTSPOT2 longBaguette, largTotale HOTSPOT2 longBaguette / 2, largTotale / 2
PROJECT2 3, 270, 2
Symbol.Script_VL: ! ===== SCRIPT PARAMETRES ===== VALUES "longBaguette" RANGE [0.20, 1.20] VALUES "diamBaguette" RANGE [0.03, 0.15] VALUES "espacement" RANGE [0.03, 0.50] VALUES "nbBaguettes" RANGE [1, 12] VALUES "nbGrignes" RANGE [1, 9]

UI_GROUPBOX "Composition", 10, 125, 424, 105 UI_OUTFIELD "Nombre de baguettes", 25, 150, 180, 20 UI_INFIELD "nbBaguettes", 230, 150, 120, 20 UI_OUTFIELD "Grignes sur le dessus", 25, 175, 180, 20 UI_INFIELD "grignes", 230, 175, 120, 20 UI_OUTFIELD "Nombre de grignes", 25, 200, 180, 20 UI_INFIELD "nbGrignes", 230, 200, 120, 20
UI_GROUPBOX "Apparence", 10, 240, 424, 80 UI_OUTFIELD "Matériau du pain", 25, 265, 180, 20 UI_INFIELD "matPain", 230, 265, 160, 20 UI_OUTFIELD "Matériau des grignes", 25, 290, 180, 20 UI_INFIELD "matGrigne", 230, 290, 160, 20
